note: THREE FILES CAUSE ALMOST EVERY MOUTH REFUSAL, AND TWO OF THEM SHOULD NEVER BE MERGED AT ALL. The Drift bounced once and campaign/the-forebay three times today, every time on exactly these: docs/audits/type-audit-report.md, docs/digest/decisions-in-force.md, docs/decisions/README.md. They conflict because every campaign touches them, not because campaigns disagree. RESOLVE THEM BY KIND, NOT BY HAND. The first two are AGGREGATES: take either side, then run make rebaseline, and the regeneration will move them AGAIN -- which means whichever side you took was wrong. That happened six times in one session on this branch, every single absorption without exception. The correct move is to take any side to clear the marker and then regenerate; the regenerated bytes are the answer and neither parent has them. Never hand-edit either. The third, docs/decisions/README.md, is a HAND-MAINTAINED index and the conflict is almost always both sides ADDING rows. Keep every row from both sides in numeric order; a take-ours or take-theirs silently drops another campaign decision from the index and nothing checks it -- docs_consistency does not verify the README against the digest, and 0146, 0148 and 0160 are missing from it right now for exactly this reason. FILED as TOOL-decision-readme-has-no-completeness-guard. SECOND OBSERVATION, cheaper than any fix: both of my bounces came from main moving between ENQUEUE and LAUNCH, not from a stale branch -- I was 0 behind when I submitted. On a busy queue, absorb immediately before make sluice rather than at the end of your close, because the window that matters is the one you cannot see.
